text:
sam: Follow-up from last night's outage—saw a correlated spike in LB retries during a cross-region failover. Need an owners list and short ETAs.
maria: agree. short and actionable please.
sre_tiffany: i'll lead on remediation and monitoring. plan: add a preflight check to the rotator that validates route convergence and SNI before switching certs; add a retry-rate anomaly alert (promql below). ETA: 7 days. JIRA: NET-1944.
leo: i'll take the quick mitigation on LB config: reduce aggressive retry policy during scheduled rotators and expose a feature flag for maintenance windows. PR by Mon. JIRA: NET-1945.
jon: i'll investigate the BGP churn correlation and retention of withdrawn routes. suspect we need longer route hold time in our peering layer. filing NET-1946. ETA: 3d for initial findings.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: planned canary: cert-rotator v4.1.0 -> v4.1.1 on 2024-12-10T02:00Z. dry-run 30m prior.
sre_tiffany: alert draft (PromQL):

```
(sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[5m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[5m]))) > 0.04
```

-> alert to #incidents, page on-call if sustained 8m.
maria: i'll own runbook updates and tenant comms: include opt-out instructions and postmortem summary. OPS-1001. ETA: 48h.
leo: short-term tweak: will add conservative backoff (cap retries to 2, multiply backoff by 2x) under feature flag. ops can enable during rollout windows.
jon: found entries in route logs where a withdrawn prefix reappeared within 10s causing transient mismatch. NET-1946 will track root cause and remediations (BGP timers, flap dampening).
sre_tiffany: post-deploy probe snippet i'll add to CI:
```
curl -sS -I https://us-lb.internal/health -H "Host: app.prod" --resolve app.prod:443:10.3.4.5 | grep -i "subject:\|sni"
```
will run per-region after canary and fail pipeline on mismatch.
maria: action table (copyable):
- sre_tiffany, NET-1944, preflight route + SNI check, add alert, 7d
- leo, NET-1945, LB retry-backoff feature flag, Mon EOD
- jon, NET-1946, BGP churn investigation, 3d
- maria, OPS-1001, runbook + tenant comms, 48h

sam: schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to review PRs and acceptance criteria.

leo: i'll post PR link when ready. ping here if priorities shift.
sre_tiffany: marking this thread as the canonical action tracker. update here with PRs and timeline changes. :white_check_mark:
